name: Driving Simulator Toronto
summary:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - through Toronto.

YOUR GARAGE
You start in a luxury three-car garage: hex LED ceiling, oak wall, a supercar either side of you. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto your drive at Humber Bay Shores.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a race cockpit: racing wheel, bucket seats, roll cage, shift lights and a live display. Grip the wheel, work the gear stick and pull the handbrake with your own hands - or drive with the joysticks.
